factory_fit.mission: Removes a narrow timestamp ambiguity before the factory ever spends effort on a collection route; it does not claim alpha or data readiness.
factory_fit.estimand: Only the label convention of this observed 15-minute OHLCV response is tested; NetReturn and research estimands remain untouched.
factory_fit.research_truth: The selected start label needed 37 usable direct trades across 18 slots and zero range contradictions, while the end model had six contradictions. Missing mapped bars and every non-selected semantic remain explicit.
factory_fit.owner_operability: The receipt says in one line what changed and what did not: bar-label ambiguity is reduced; a usable research panel still does not exist.
factory_fit.flexibility: The runner is one bounded stdlib tool; it selects no provider and creates no collector, adapter, scheduler, schema migration, or platform dependency.
factory_fit.monitoring_and_recovery: No process stays alive. Exact raw bytes and a manifest are retained outside Git; malformed or insufficient future evidence resolves fail-closed without retry or fallback.
factory_fit.economics: Two keyless public reads, zero credential use and zero cash spend are below the cost of a 24-hour capture that could have inherited a one-bar error.
factory_fit.security: Host, scheme, paths, request count, keyless mode, redirect handling, raw root, and zero wallet/signer boundary are code-tested.
factory_fit.build_vs_buy: A small project-owned evaluator is justified only for the project's timestamp-truth boundary. It wraps no SDK and does not substitute for a market-data provider.
factory_fit.red_team: A successful two-read result cannot become a continuous panel, empty/no-trade proof, H07/H01 result, trial, execution, settlement, or numeric-return claim; tests reject the promoted paths.

product_horizon_radar.now: No collector is justified by A10 alone. The next owner decision is whether the reduced label uncertainty materially changes the need for a separately bounded data-route experiment.
product_horizon_radar.watch_trigger: If a future named route cannot emit every closed interval as an observation or typed gap with independently auditable availability time, stop before any hypothesis trial and return to reuse-first.
